stem: What were two effects of this canal on the United States during the early-to-mid 1800s?

options.label: F
options.text: The Northeast gained access to new trade networks, and the Midwest opened for more settlement.

options.label: G
options.text: The South became less dependent on slave labor, while the North became more dependent on indentured servants.

options.label: H
options.text: The West became the commercial center of the nation, while the Northeast increased dependence on agricultural production.

options.label: J
options.text: The South experienced lower shipping costs, and the West expanded international trade.
